title: persea carolinensis var. palustris
intro: Persea carolinensis var. palustris, commonly known as American sassafras swamp or American sassafras var. palustris, is a plant species within the family Lauraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including relieving digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Persea carolinensis var. palustris include acting as a carminative, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which helps to soothe the digestive system, reduce swelling, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include safrole, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, although it is also known to be toxic in large quantities.
